newsitem.title: FINLAND: Amer says K-shareholder to sell to Dutch.
newsitem.headline: Amer says K-shareholder to sell to Dutch.

text.p: Finnish sporting goods group Amer-yhtyma Oy said on Friday one of its vote-heavy K shareholders planned to sell 275,000 K shares to Dutch Dirk Hus Beheer BV for 75 million markka.

"A representative of the Student Union of the Helsinki School of Economics and Business Administration (KY) has told Amer ... that the student union plans to sell 275,000 of its Amer-yhtyma K shares to Dutch Dirk Hus Beheer," Amer said in a statement.
"The sale price totals 75,251,000 markka," it said.

British investor Jonathan Bryan Guinness, the third Lord Moyne, said on Monday he had agreed to buy 275,000 Amer K-shares from KY for 75 million markka. He earlier had a deal to buy control in the company which subsequently fell through.
KY has held 540,000 vote-strong but unlisted Amer K-shares with a total voting stake in the company of 25 percent.
It was not immediately clear how Friday's deal related to the stake Guinness was buying, an Amer spokeswoman told Reuters.
"Unfortunately, KY's announcement does not say," she said.
Nobody at KY was immediately available to comment.
